root_cause.text: The `idpf_idc_vport_dev_down` function attempts to dereference `vport->vdev_info` without checking if it is NULL, which occurs when a vport does not support RDMA and thus does not have `vdev_info` allocated.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff adds `!vport->vdev_info` to the safety check in `idpf_idc_vport_dev_down()` before calling `idpf_unplug_aux_dev(vport->vdev_info->adev)`.

bic_trace_step.reason: The function `idpf_idc_vport_dev_down` introduced in this commit iterates over all allocated vports and dereferences `vport->vdev_info` on lines 262-263 (`idpf_unplug_aux_dev(vport->vdev_info->adev);` and `vport->vdev_info->adev = NULL;`) without checking if `vport->vdev_info` is NULL. Since `vport->vdev_info` is only allocated if RDMA is enabled (as seen in `idpf_idc_init_aux_vport_dev`), this will cause a NULL pointer dereference for any vport that does not support RDMA.
